items.headline: Blizzard Warning issued May 11 at 1:23PM AKDT until May 11 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Blizzard conditions. Winds gusting as high as 40 mph.

* WHERE...Point Lay.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Areas of blowing snow could
reduce visibility to a quarter mile or less at times.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...No falling snow is expected. The blowing snow
is low to the ground.
items.instruction:
Travel should be restricted to emergencies only. If you must travel,
have a winter survival kit with you. If you get stranded, stay with
your vehicle.

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 11 at 11:07AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Rampart and Tanana.

The Yukon River breakup front is currently downstream of Rampart.
The River Watch team will fly to Tanana today (Monday May 11th) to
report on surrounding ice conditions. Updates will be posted as
available.
